title: Summit Partner Earning Rules
content:
Partner activity earns in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program as the partner reports it.

**Rule.** Partner activity earns the miles the partner reports for the transaction. On partner airline activity the member also earns the partner elite bonus percent of the member's tier, taken of the partner's base miles and rounded down to the whole mile. Hotel, car rental, co-branded card and dining activity carries no elite bonus. Partner activity never earns qualifying dollars.

**Once per transaction.** Each partner transaction is credited once, identified by the kind of partner and the partner's transaction reference together. A second posting with the same kind of partner and the same reference is not made; the same reference under a different kind of partner is a different transaction.

**Membership status.** Partner accrual posts only to a membership whose status is enrolled, active or dormant, and it counts as qualifying activity.

| Kind of partner | Reported miles credited | Elite bonus | Qualifying dollars |
|---|---|---|---|
| Partner airline | Yes | Tier's partner elite bonus percent of base miles, rounded down | None |
| Hotel | Yes | None | None |
| Car rental | Yes | None | None |
| Co-branded card | Yes | None | None |
| Dining | Yes | None | None |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A partner airline reports 1234 base miles for a member whose tier bonus is 25 percent: 25 percent of 1234 is 308.5, rounded down to 308, so 1542 miles are credited in total. The same 1234 miles reported by a hotel partner credit 1234 miles.
